items.title: $5m home which sold after a week believed to be record-breaker
items.summary: A property in Renmark has broken the region's record for the most expensive house after selling for $5 million. The five-bedroom property was taken off the market after a week.

items.title: Two men sanctioned over Iran-backed antisemitic arson attacks
items.summary: Two men accused of organising the 2024 arson attacks in Sydney and Melbourne from abroad have been hit with sanctions.

items.title: Drunk driver jailed for 10 years for killing father and son
items.summary: The court heard Trevor Galbraith had a blood alcohol reading nearly four times over the legal limit and was reading a message on his phone when the ute he was driving mounted a curb and struck the father and son.

items.title: Twelfth teen charged over alleged group bashing at Gold Coast schoolies
items.summary: A twelfth person has been charged over the alleged group bashing of a 15-year-old during schoolies celebrations on the Gold Coast.

items.title: ACCC concludes inquiry into misleading food labelling claims on Four Corners
items.summary: Australia's consumer watchdog says it has concluded its inquiries into allegations of food fraud aired by Four Corners, finding no evidence of misleading labelling on two types of food products.

items.title: Reflecting on 2026 with the year's best political cartoons

items.title: Mushroom killer Erin Patterson asks High Court to hear appeal
items.summary: Lawyers for the triple murderer have lodged the bid on the final day of the appeal window.

items.title: Safety risks and 'blank screen' in defibrillators prompt SA ambos warning
items.summary: The South Australian government will provide ambulances with back-up defibrillators after paramedics are warned about potential safety issues to its current equipment, including a delay in defibrillating patients.
